title: Personal Loans Returned-Payment Fees: Share After a Completed Term Extension Modification
content:
## Rule

A returned-fee modification share applies to a Personal Loans loan whose Term Extension Modification was completed: completion fewer than 36 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the returned-payment fee's assessment date gives 0.9; completion 36 to 59 whole months before gives 0.95; any other loan gives no returned-fee share.

The modification is the loan's Term Extension Modification under the Hardship Assistance Programs in completed status, its completion date being the closing date on that plan's record.

The share multiplies the returned-payment fee amount while it is still unrounded.

| Whole months from completion to the assessment date | Share |
|---|---|
| fewer than 36 | 0.9 |
| 36 to 59 | 0.95 |
| 60 or more, or no completed modification | no share |

## Cases (hypothetical, assessment on 31 May)

- Completed 30 June three years before: 35 whole months: 0.9.
- Completed 31 May three years before: 36 whole months: 0.95.
